title: iPhone Duo Simulator: Testing and optimizing your SwiftUI app
summary: Antoine van der Lee pairs a screen-by-screen SwiftUI agent audit with simulator checks for compact and regular layouts, folding, rotation, and preserved navigation state. His migration example replaces a cramped onboarding layout with an arranged view, while keeping agent suggestions subject to transition testing and real-device checks.
takeaway: Review one screen at a time with explicit layout and state constraints, then test folding, rotation, keyboard, and navigation transitions before accepting the migration.
